copy_label: Week 5 simulation preview, powered by SnapScore + generalized SnapSim

manifest.data_cutoff: all rows before 2025 Week 5 for simulation inputs; Week 5 actuals used only for validation display
manifest.snapscore_source: snapcore.demo.demo_data.json generated by M4-snap canonical XGBoost demo runner
manifest.simulator_source: generalized SnapSim drive-by-drive Monte Carlo with per-team coach/team play-calling models
manifest.points_calibration: primitive drive points scaled to pre-kickoff total_line; yardage distributions remain SnapSim-derived

run_story.label: Load Week 5 slate
run_story.detail: Read 14 scheduled games and market totals from schedules.parquet.

run_story.label: Freeze preconditions
run_story.detail: Restrict player form, usage, and play-calling inputs to 2025 W1-W4 plus prior seasons.

run_story.label: Fit play-calling profiles
run_story.detail: Fit per-team coach/team play-class models from pre-week play-by-play.

run_story.label: Run full-slate Monte Carlo
run_story.detail: Simulate 14 games x 300 outcomes before reading Week 5 actuals.

run_story.label: Attach SnapScore candidates
run_story.detail: Map player-level upside projections onto simulated team distributions.

run_story.label: Validate after the game
run_story.detail: Compare predictions to Week 5 actuals only in the evidence table.

glossary.MAE: Mean absolute error: the average absolute gap between the model projection and what happened.
glossary.huge_game: A player-week where the player's result was more than one as-of standard deviation above his own baseline.
glossary.walk_forward: The model trains only on games before the prediction week, then predicts the target week.
glossary.simulation_preview: A full-slate Monte Carlo run generated from pre-week inputs, served with provenance for demo inspection.
